title: Sandbox CI directive
description: A behaviour directive stored as directives/<id>.json. Documentation only: runner/rules.mjs validates by hand. Rules the schema cannot express: id must equal the filename stem; breaksWith must not list the directive's own id; setting flakeRate with an outcome other than flake is a warning; unknown keys are warnings, not errors.

id.description: Directive id. Must equal the filename stem (directives/<id>.json).

title.description: Human-readable title shown in logs and the job summary.

durationSec.description: Simulated duration in seconds. The run time is the max over the active directives.

outcome.description: pass, fail (fails at durationSec) or flake (fails at durationSec with probability flakeRate, re-rolled on every run).

flakeRate.description: Probability of failing, in (0, 1]. Required when outcome is flake; a warning with any other outcome.

breaksWith.description: Ids this directive breaks with. Symmetric: either side may declare it. The pair fails when both are present and at least one is active. Ids that do not exist are inert.

conflictKey.description: Names the file conflicts/<conflictKey>.txt that the PR also edits. Validated only; the merge conflict itself comes from that file.
